description: A heated vessel in which soaked glue is simmered to a working fluid. It is scoured clean before fresh glue is added, and a stringy batch can be loosened by spinning the brush rapidly in the pot.
name: glue-pot

source_ref.label: Douglas Cockerell, Bookbinding and the Care of Books (1901), Chapter XX, p.290. Internet Archive.
